title: Study Comparing Urinary Diversion (Transurethral/Suprapubic) After Radical Prostatectomy
brief_summary: The study aims to show the technical feasibility of the suprapubic urinary diversion after endoscopic extraperitoneal radical prostatectomy (EERPE) and has a greater comfort for the patients with at least the same catheter complication rate in comparison to the urethral urinary diversion.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Adenocarcinoma of the prostate,
* Subjects treated by conventional or robotic assisted laparoscopic prostatectomy
* Be willing/able to adhere to follow up visits

Exclusion Criteria:

* Subjects treated by retropubic or perineal prostatectomy Subjects with known bladder cancer
* Contraindications for anticholinergic drugs
* Waist measurement \> 100 cm
* No written informed consent
* Age \< 18 years
* Subjects with known narrow-angle glaucoma
